summary: Version 2 compiles and passes topology (must_repair=false, critic score 0.9). It draws MN through O, the semicircle arc MNP centred at O (radius 238 px, not a full circle), the named path O--A--P, O--B and A--B, with labels P, B, A, O, M, N in their bound positions. The v2 code emits explicit \fill[black] circle (1.2pt) markers at O, A and B.

Labels A, B, C, D, E, O are present. The label previously misread as "Z" near (371,349) was confirmed by inspection as "E". The figure shows a circle centred at O, tangent to CB at D, with right-angle marks at C and D. The unlabelled circle crossing on AC was intentionally left unlabelled.
